entry.title: "But marinade" and leaked passwords are what researchers found in ChatGPT's hidden reasoning
entry.summary: Security researchers found a vulnerability in the APIs of OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google that lets them extract encrypted reasoning traces and move them between models. A scan of public sessions turned up dozens of passwords and API keys. The traces also show that the reasoning summaries users see often hide what the models are actually doing.
